name: analyze_keyword_topic_tool
description: This specialist extracts semantic keywords and topics from source material.

full_text_uri.description: S3 URI for the page's full-text extraction.

correlation_specialist_uri.description: Optional S3 URI for the page's correlated content spine.

source_image_path.description: Optional source image URI retained for audit correlation.

page_number.description: Page number represented by the text artifacts.

aws_profile.description: Optional AWS profile name for Bedrock authentication.

job_id.description: Identifier of the analysis run this invocation belongs to. Pass through the job_id supplied in the orchestrator context. Omit only when no analysis run is active.

doc_id.description: Identifier of the source document being analysed. Pass through the doc_id supplied in the orchestrator context.
